purpose: Stage best for deterministic/static replay gates that need retained cached stereo rough distance plus observable motion/unknown/far-loss refresh hooks, while keeping static cache-reuse overhead below the hard performance gate.
expected_effect: Preserve candidate_0014-style cached ApproxStereoContour evidence in static replay.
Keep refresh observability active through profile.csv, frame_metrics.csv, events.csv, and run_score.json.
Improve static replay p95 margin compared with candidate_0014 and candidate_0016.
applicability: low-motion scenes where cached color contours remain aligned
static replay comparisons that need refresh/cache metrics without claiming motion validation
validation_evidence: replay_static_refresh_variants_001: 3/3 pass for candidate_0017 on near_single_object, far_cabinet, and depth_hole_black_object.
Average p95 was about 80.396 ms across the static smoke cases.
Scored frames had color_contour_refresh_count=0 and color_contour_cache_reuse_count=3, so this validates static cache reuse overhead only.
risk: Motion, occlusion, and reappearance behavior is unproven until slow_pan_far_object and hand_occlusion_reappear replay datasets exist.
Higher motion and unknown thresholds can miss subtle cache drift.
